pages.title: A Lit Lantern
pages.body: A lantern sways at the far end of the landing, though no hand holds it.

lines.speaker: narration
lines.text: A lantern sways at the far end of the landing, though no hand holds it. Its light is warm, and it is waiting for you.

lines.speaker: sheep
lines.text: Another reality, another landing. Prince says this one has excellent monsters. I believe him about half the time.

lines.speaker: sheep
lines.text: The other half, he sends me in first. If that lantern starts talking, I am not the one answering it.

lines.speaker: owl
lines.text: Hold still, both of you. That lantern burns from the far side of the wall, so somebody in the next reality lit it for us. Whoever they are, they are expecting company, and they are not a patient host.

requires.reason: Prince does not pay that well

outcomes.result: The lantern leads you down a stair of old stone. A few coins glint on the steps, and at the bottom someone large is already warming his paws at it.
The lantern leads you down a stair of old stone. A few coins glint on the steps.

pages.title: The Lantern Bearer
pages.body: Bjorn is already at the bottom of the stair.

lines.speaker: bear
lines.text: Ha! I knew I smelled lamp oil. Took you long enough. Stand back, little ones, this light bites.

lines.speaker: narration
lines.text: The lantern gutters once, as if it heard him.

lines.speaker: narration
lines.text: The stair is empty. Whoever lit the lantern has gone on ahead, and left the light for you.

lines.speaker: narration
lines.text: At the end of the stair the lantern goes out, as if it had done its job.

lines.speaker: narration
lines.text: Somewhere above, a door you never noticed closes softly.

outcomes.result: You leave with the lantern's warmth still in your paws. Prince will call it a detour. It was not.
